author: reek
body: The World Forge, written entirely in Codex and compiled to JavaScript by the html plug. NameForge and StoryGraph run CLIENT-SIDE in the browser: pick a seed, an archetype, and a motif, and the page generates a whole named setting and a branching story graph -- no server round-trip, no hand-written JS. Deterministic: the same seed+archetype+motif is the same world and saga.
